summary: Only a November 1971 notice of bids to remove ten Ottawa National Forest towers names the Mallard tower; no build, staffing or current-site record found.

events.note: Bids to remove ten fire towers were announced by the Ottawa National Forest supervisor. The notice places the Mallard lookout tower on the Iron River District. It does not say the Mallard tower was removed.

notes_for_editor: Record agency Ottawa National Forest and county Iron are supported by the 1971 notice. Only one tower-specific source. The notice does not say whether Mallard was among the ten towers, so no removal event is set. No build date, staffing, access or current-site evidence found. Topo-map sites name a Mallard Lake Lookout Tower near 46.297, -88.982; that shows a name and location, not status, so not cited. An Ottawa National Forest or Iron River district history search may settle the removal outcome.
